ru.text_entry_help_tooltip:
The notes section has limited HTML capabilities.
Use the following commands with < and > in place of the apostrophes.
-'br' to start a new line.
-Encase text between 'b' and '/b' to bold.
-Encase text between 'i' and '/i' to italicize.
-Encase text between 'u' and '/u' to underline.

The following font related codes can be used, but keep in mind that not all font faces will work.
-Encase text between 'font face = name of font you wish to use' and '/font' to change the font face.
-Encase text between 'font color= #hex code of the color' and '/font' to change the color of the text.
-Encase text between 'font size=number of size' and '/font' to change the text size.
